description: This file contains a PHP class named 'User' within the namespace Opencart.Admin.Model.User. The class provides methods for managing user data, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving users and their related information such as login history and user groups. It appears to be part of the backend model layer of an OpenCart administration system.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Model class for User management in the OpenCart admin system. It provides CRUD operations and various retrieval functions for user data.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Inserts a new user record into the database with provided data, including username, password, email, name, image, status, and date added.

methods.name: editUser
methods.description: Updates an existing user's details identified by user_id. Supports changing username, group, name, email, image, status, and optionally password.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Updates the password for a specific user identified by user_id.

methods.name: editCode
methods.description: Sets a recovery or verification code for a user identified by email.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Removes a user and associated authorizations and login records from the database.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a user by user_id, including user group name.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Fetches a user record based on username.

methods.name: getUserByEmail
methods.description: Fetches a user record based on email address.

methods.name: getUserByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a user record associated with a specific code, used for password recovery or email verification.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Returns a list of users, supporting various filters like username, name, email, user group, IP, and status, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalUsers
methods.description: Counts total users matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalUsersByGroupId
methods.description: Counts users belonging to a specific user group.

methods.name: getTotalUsersByEmail
methods.description: Counts users with a specific email address.

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Records a login event for a user with IP and user agent.

methods.name: deleteLogins
methods.description: Deletes login history records for a specific user.

methods.name: deleteLogins
methods.description: Deletes login records for a specified user identified by user_id.

methods.name: getLogins
methods.description: Retrieves login history data for a specified user, supporting pagination with start and limit parameters.

methods.name: getTotalLogins
methods.description: Returns the total number of login events for a user.

methods.name: addAuthorize
methods.description: Inserts a new authorization record for a user with data such as token, IP, and user agent.

methods.name: editAuthorizeStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a user authorization entry.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotal
methods.description: Updates the total count of an authorization record.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotalByUserId
methods.description: Updates the total authorization count for a user identified by user_id.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Deletes authorization records for a user, optionally specifying a particular authorization ID.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific authorization record by user_authorize_id.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Retrieves an authorization record based on user_id and token, including an attempt count.

methods.name: getAuthorizes
methods.description: Lists authorization records for a user, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalAuthorizes
methods.description: Counts the total number of authorization records for a user.
